answer: Charge each identity a per-epoch entry fee payable only in coins earned through graded work, and burn the fee on payment, like a dawn toll collected fresh each day. A pigment mark cannot be washed off and reused: the coins are destroyed, never refunded or transferred, so every fake identity must first produce real peer-graded work to fund its own entry. An attacker running a hundred fakes must fund a hundred burned fees, and the anchor of earned history cannot be bought in bulk or shared across identities, so the cost of each extra fake stays full price with no discount for scale.
